selection.candidate_rule: English topics belonging to any base group ID; union by topic ID. Historical candidate set before approved exclusions and additions.
selection.selected_count_basis: Approved source topic IDs in the acquired archive; no processed corpus file has been produced.

approval.scope: Initial topic selection and recording in snapshot.json and sources.md. No corpus processing, commit or push.
approval.basis: Explicit user approval after review of the 401-topic proposal.

selection.rule: Take English topics from the base specialty groups, remove the seven explicit excluded topic IDs from every specialty set, add the twelve explicit supplemental topic IDs to Urology, and deduplicate by topic ID.

limitations: Archive integrity and member digests were checked locally; no upstream expected checksum was verified.
Source, candidate and approved selected-topic counts are measured against the source archive. Processed/retained corpus and passage counts remain unmeasured.
Full summaries were read for the nineteen explicit exclusion/addition decisions. The other 389 retained base candidates have not received an individual semantic summary review.
The initial selection omits leukemia-focused topics and twelve supplemental-group topics; answerability and retrieval coverage remain to be measured.
No linked pages were fetched, no corpus content was redistributed, and no ingestion module, embeddings or index were created.
A-001 is complete for acquisition/provenance and initial selection only; processed corpus, passages, embeddings, retrieval and answer-quality checks remain incomplete.

metadata_inspection.method: One-off read-only local inspection using Python standard-library XML parsing; no ingestion module was implemented and no files were extracted to disk.

coverage_review.broad_group_example: The cardiovascular/pulmonary candidate set includes Acute Lymphocytic Leukemia and Acute Myeloid Leukemia.

focused_review.reviewer: Agent review; user approved the initial scope choice.
focused_review.scope: Topic selection only. No clinical expert validation, question-level semantic support assessment or retrieval-quality measurement is claimed.

task_acceptance.authorization: Explicit user approval to perform the final acceptance review and mark only A-001 complete if its criteria pass.
task_acceptance.workflow: Owner-local acceptance review of A-001 only; no full Spec Kit implementation workflow was invoked.

acceptance.fields_reuse_and_attribution: Reviewed in docs/rag/sources.md; source guidance URLs and attribution are recorded.
acceptance.authorized_source_acquisition: The explicitly approved dated Health Topic ZIP was downloaded; no outbound linked content was fetched.
acceptance.actual_snapshot_and_checksums: Recorded archive/member sizes, release/retrieval dates and locally computed SHA-256 digests match the local source.
acceptance.measured_topic_counts: 2033 source topics, 1017 English records, 396 original candidates and 401 approved selected topic IDs.

verification.local_checks: ZIP CRC, archive/member sizes and SHA-256, selected-ID uniqueness and rule reconstruction, title/URL/summary/creation-date presence, topic counts and Git exclusion of the raw archive passed.

task_acceptance.evidence_type: Actual authorized source download followed by offline checks of the acquired archive; not a mock or a running RAG service.
task_acceptance.paid_provider_and_deployment_checks: Not applicable to A-001; not run.
task_acceptance.completion_boundary: Acquisition, source/reuse review, provenance and initial selection only. A-002 ingestion/chunking, A-003 embedding/indexing and later retrieval/generation/evaluation tasks remain incomplete.
